This is the bonus track from Man's Best Friend.

It has been uploaded in MP3, but it was for sale as a digital download on her website for a day so I think it was available in lossless quality. No one has uploaded the lossless version yet!

I found some files on Soulseek that were in FLAC, but when I tested them they were just upscaled MP3 files.

Can anyone help? I'd even take a vinyl rip at this point if it was actual lossless quality!
